flagged.title: Business Ownership & Limited Liability
flagged.reason: The video both displays on screen and states in voiceover that a partnership has between 2 and 20 owners, which teaches an outdated cap repealed in 2002 and would cause a student to fail the lesson quiz question on partnership size limits.

mark_affecting.quote: This is a business with between two and twenty owners.

flagged.title: Stakeholders in Business
flagged.reason: The video states that Boohoo's sales plummeted following the Leicester factory scandal when revenue actually rose, which would cause a student to be marked wrong on a question in this lesson.

mark_affecting.quote: Sales plummeted. And their share price? It halved.

mark_affecting.quote: I'm going to rapidly guide you through the seven ways of working your OCR syllabus names... Fourth, zero-hour contracts...
